feeds.title: Successful Black Parenting Magazine
feeds.description: Successful Black Parenting is a magazine website that portrays the unique characteristics and lifestyle of the Black family. They offer information on child development, parenting and other family issues important to adults working with or raising Black children.

feeds.title: LagosMums
feeds.description: LagosMums is a family life and parenting resource for mums, parents, and caregivers raising children and the family in the 21st century.

feeds.title: Jadore Fashion
feeds.description: Stella shares daily outfit posts, current obsessions & cravings, street style inspirations, lifestyle including traveling and her Nigerian culture.

feeds.title: Heritage Mom Blog
feeds.description: My name is Amber O'Neal Johnston, and I started this blog as a way to document and discuss the joys and trials of raising my kids to love themselves and others. Along with advice and inspiration, I as a mom of four offer a path forward for parents of all backgrounds who are craving a life-giving home that fosters values of diversity, kinship, equity, and inclusion.

feeds.title: The Traveling Child
feeds.description: We're the Hambricks- Monet, James, Jordyn, and Kennedy. Monet is the planner, photographer, and writer, James goes with the flow, Jordyn is the adventure junkie, and Kennedy keeps us in check. Most of our travels are based on flight deals and we share tips for affording travel. You'll find itineraries for every trip we've on to make your planning process easier. When we're not traveling we're providing tips on keeping kids busy and educated at home, managing natural hair, and staying fit.

feeds.title: Bianca Dottin Blog
feeds.description: Bianca Dottin, a vibrant lifestyle expert and mama, resides in sunny Orlando, FL. With a degree in Communications from UCF, she's an adventurer passionate about travelling, food, and photography. Through her blog, she inspires moms to embrace motherhood, married life, style, travel, and family recipes, fostering a life they adore, one day at a time.

feeds.title: The Kisha Project
feeds.description: The author Kisha is an Afro-Latina wife, mom, and former flight attendant. Born in Panama, raised in Little Rock currently residing in Phoenix. She shares insights about motherhood, parenting, lifestyle, and much more on her blog.

feeds.title: Off The Record Mom Blog
feeds.description: Here, at OFF THE RECORD MOM, we talk about all things ranging from 'How to parent with patience,' 'How to build your business from scratch,' and 'The Summer's Hottest Freakum Dresses.'

feeds.title: Our Twisted, Beautiful Journey
feeds.description: Our Twisted, Beautiful Journey is a Black Parenting Mom Blog by Misty Cowherd, tackling common family issues from the perspective of raising black children in an informative and sometimes humorous way.

feeds.title: Fab Mum
feeds.description: Fabmummg is a parenting and motherhood resource site for mums. We are committed to sharing content to inspire, motivate, encourage and educate you on your parenting and motherhood journey.

feeds.title: Mommi Nation Blog
feeds.description: MommiNation is the #1 resource and virtual community for Black Moms. Tackling every topic on your Motherhood journey in a relatable. At MommiNation we believe that it takes a village to raise a child and a NATION to support a Mom. We are committed to sharing everything about motherhood you never thought you needed to know so that we become your most favorite and most reliable resource as you tackle motherhood with even more confidence and clarity!

feeds.title: Sincerely Onyi
feeds.description: I'm Onyi, a physician assistant, millennial mommy, and a long distance wife. My goal is to help like minded women find balance in this crazy thing we call life. Sincerely Onyi has a focus on parenting, lifestyle, beauty, travel, marriage and the healthcare industry.

feeds.title: 2blackmomsandamic Blog
feeds.description: 2 Black moms navigating through life, sharing, and caring about parenting, careers, friendships, educating our children and ourselves and enjoying life. They will explore the range of issues on the minds of black moms everywhere, including helping your high school student navigate the college admissions process, resources tailored to the educational achievement of black children, battling the continuing problem of educational disparities, letting go and letting your child live their best life.

feeds.title: Houseful Of Nicholes
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Natasha - the face behind and the mom in charge of this award-winning blog, Houseful of Nicholes. I'm a maker by nature. I love making things. Sewing. Knitting. Canning. Preserving. Building. I love it all, and various posts will reflect that at any given time. I also share my expertise on travel, homeschooling three young children and marriage for young and old folk alike.

feeds.title: Black Mom Chronicles
feeds.description: My name is Karabo Mokoena and I am a South African Mommy Blogger, Parenting Writer and Content Producer. Becoming a mother reconnected me to parts of my childhood that I needed to heal from, and here, I share stories about letting go of my conditioning in order to parent my daughter as consciously as possible.

feeds.title: Hey, Black Mom! Blog
feeds.description: Hey, Black Mom! amplifies the voices and stories of Black mothers and provides a digital space and community to highlight Black motherhood out loud. Driven by narratives that melanin mommies can relate to, we celebrate Black motherhood through publishing content that informs and inspires. We are proud to offer distinctive stories that applaud our voices while providing a much-needed sense of community to an underserved group of women in the online media space.

feeds.title: Mattie James Blog
feeds.description: Mattie James, a renowned lifestyle influencer and entrepreneur, offers insights into her daily life and passions on her blog. From family and decor to travel and recipes, she provides diverse content. Follow her for fashion, shopping advice, beauty reviews, and a plethora of lifestyle tips and tricks.

feeds.title: Tessy Onyia
feeds.description: I'm Tessy, a Nigerian lifestyle blogger, a wife, a mum of 3 children, an entrepreneur, and a lover of God. The blog is a Nigerian Lifestyle blog that covers topics like family, relationship, pregnancy and childbirth, parenting, health, fashion, blogging, and general knowledge topics.

feeds.title: The Cuddle Blog
feeds.description: My name is Tomi. The Cuddle Blog is a blog about pregnancy, life as a new mother, parenting, and working from home.

feeds.title: Glam O' Sphere
feeds.description: Glam O' Sphere is a top beauty & makeup blog in Nigeria and also a beauty company created to cater to different beauty and fashion needs of the everyday woman, the professional, the girl-next-door, the student and the housewife.

feeds.title: Hey Trina
feeds.description: Wife, mom, and fashion-obsessed shopaholic, Trina, knows that being fab has no starting age.HeyTrina.com chronicles all of Trina's adventures in fashion with her daughters in tow. As a top Atlanta Mom Fashion Blogger, Trina has partnered with Neiman Marcus, Johnson Johnson, Verizon, Pandora, McDonald's, Carter's, and more.

feeds.title: Lifting As We Climb
feeds.description: Real-time reflection on empty nest life as my daughter transitions to college. This journey is meant to be shared.

feeds.title: Cherish365
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jennifer Borget, a part-time journalist, full-time wife, and mother striving to make the world a better place and inspiring others to do the same. Cherish 365 is the space where I share my experiences as a millennial mom, our stories, and lessons we learn as we strive to make a difference, photography and videography tips, and our family travel adventures. Follow the blog to get the latest updates about my journey in making the most of every day.

feeds.title: mater mea Blog
feeds.description: Blog about raising black kids, parenting, life, career, and building community with other black mothers nationwide. mater mea is your destination for thoughtful, high-quality content that celebrates, supports, and empowers black moms, as well as women on their journey to motherhood.

feeds.title: Mommy Talk Show
feeds.description: Mommy Talk Show was created by Emmy award-winning TV Journalist Joyce Brewer. The parenting talk show features video reviews, parenting news, webcasts and is taped on-location at the newest & coolest family friendly businesses in Atlanta.

feeds.title: My American Meltingpot
feeds.description: Lori L. Tharps is a journalist and author whose work lands at the intersection of race and popular culture. A public intellectual, Tharps strives to use her words to broaden the conversation about race in America; to challenge racial stereotypes; to dismantle white supremacy; and to celebrate ethnic and cultural diversity whenever possible.

feeds.title: Black And Married With Kids
feeds.description: Lamar and Ronnie Tyler make up the husband and wife power pair behind Black and Married with Kids, the largest independent African American marriage and parenting site on the web. Black and Married With Kids is the web's most popular destination for guidance on African American marriage and parenting.

feeds.title: Rattles & Heels
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Adanna! I was born and raised on the beautiful island of Grenada. As an only child, I was always clueless and awkward around children. Now, I'm a 30-something millennial mom and can't imagine my life without my children. I'm a free-spirit at heart with big dreams to travel the country and the whole wide world. You can read all about our family's travels here.

feeds.title: Nakisha Wynn Blog
feeds.description: Nakisha Wynn, an Orlando-based family lifestyle blog, empowers single working moms to thrive in every aspect of life. From single parenting to entrepreneurship, she shares candid insights and practical tips for juggling business, motherhood, finances, and self-care. Through personal stories and strategies, Nakisha inspires women to create fulfilling lives while embracing imperfection and pursuing their dreams.

feeds.title: Sisi Yėmmié
feeds.description: SisiYemmie.Com is a food and lifestyle Blog.Sisi Yemmié is a personal blog depicting daily life of the author.

feeds.title: Sisi Yemmie
feeds.description: My name is Yemisi Odusanya, welcome to my blog! A Nigerian lifestyle blog about food, motherhood, relationships, career, beauty, and blogging!

feeds.title: Black Mothers United Blog
feeds.description: Know about more blogger moms, articles on becoming mother, support available to would-be-mothers and more! Welcome to Black Mothers United, a celebration of Black motherhood and safe space in Sacramento, CA. We are a team of African American mothers dedicated to enhancing healthy birth outcomes for African American women and their babies.

feeds.title: Black Angel Mom Blog
feeds.description: Explore articles featuring my life as a mom with A little healing, a little humor, a lot of soul. I am a wife, a mother, a daughter, a black feminist and a student of life. My work focuses on the empowerment of womyn, the validation of life and experience, healing from broken places and valuing of our humanity.

feeds.title: Adoptive Black Mom
feeds.description: Adoptive Black Mom, a professional single mother, shares her poignant journey of adoption. At 39, she embraced motherhood alone, defying societal norms. Now at 50, she reflects on the potholes and joys of parenting, offering insights and solace to others navigating similar paths.

feeds.title: Mommy Week
feeds.description: Here on MommyWeek, you can find family fun tips, homeschool advice, family travel info, simple healthy recipes, natural health remedies, DIY projects, and self-care solutions! Authored by Ashley Marshall.

feeds.title: Linda Lanre-Odumesi
feeds.description: Lifestyle, Food, Motherhood, Relationship, Finance, Positivity, Impactful living and above all God.

feeds.title: Purposeful and Meaningful
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Ifeoma Samuel. A wife and mom who loves Jesus. Welcome to a home for women who are eager to learn, grow and connect through God's WordI love serving up fresh meals of grace. That's mostly what you would find here: Bible Studies, Prayer resources and Devotionals.

feeds.title: Are Those Your Kids
feeds.description: In this blog hear about how Diedre challenges her negative and positive experiences & gives advice to other multiracial/multicultural families on how to handle it all. This blog was created to share my experiences in motherhood, from the perspective of a mom with biracial kids.

feeds.title: Single Black Motherhood Blog
feeds.description: Kim, a 26-year-old working mother, shares her single Black motherhood journey on Single Black Motherhood. Through podcasting and blogging, she offers insights, tips, and inspiration to fellow moms. Kim's enthusiasm for connecting and uplifting others shines through as she navigates the challenges and joys of parenting with honesty and grace.

feeds.title: Modern Zulu Mom
feeds.description: My name is Thando and I'm the mom and blogger behind Modern Zulu Mom. I started this blog in 2015, with the intention of engaging and connecting modern mothers in real, meaningful conversations about our children, our cultures and all things parenting. I'm passionate about family, connecting with others and expressing myself creatively through writing.

feeds.title: Oneika the Traveller Blog
feeds.description: This is a travel and lifestyle blog penned by a Jamaican-Canadian who has been to nearly 100 countries. Toronto-born but New York City-based, she is obsessed with experiencing everything this gorgeous planet has to offer. This travel blog is dedicated to inspiring, encouraging, and empowering women and people of color to see the world.

feeds.title: This That Beauty
feeds.description: Felicia is a Publisher and Editor in Chief for ThisThatBeauty, a top-rated blog that features fashion, product reviews, trend spotting, industry interviews, and more.

feeds.title: What MJ Loves
feeds.description: Hi friends, MJ here. I'm a thirty-something wife and mama to Zoë & Baby E. So much has changed in my life since motherhood. I share my experiences (good, bad and otherwise). I believe in sharing the authenticity of motherhood. You never know who can relate or who can help.

feeds.title: Igbocurls
feeds.description: My name is Chinwe Juliet and I create authentic content that will help you grow your natural hair long, make motherhood more fun and enlighten you on different tips and tricks to enhance your lifestyle. Chinwe Juliet is a top Beauty Blogger in Africa.

feeds.title: Wives Connection
feeds.description: We focus basically on life in Nigeria and how it affects Nigerian women especially wives and Mothers. We share our burdens, discuss, and try to find solutions from shared experiences. Food is very important to our families, so, we share recipes for babies and food recipes for the whole family.
